title: Compact Route/Model Lens: Unified Performance Tiles and Chart Specs
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design a compact, scan-friendly 'lens' for the Redwood Console that surfaces per-route and per-model performance: latency p50/p95/p99, throughput (reqs/sec), token counts, and cost-per-token estimates. The lens should be embeddable in route and model pages and available as a tiled summary in the Performance Overview. Focus on mobile and narrow-screen behaviors, a minimal visual footprint for usage in lists, and clear drill paths into full charts.
goals: Deliver a compact tile + expanded flyout pattern that balances information density and scannability
Provide consistent metric naming and aggregation rules across route and model pages
Include chart specs for sparkline, waterfall, and distribution views to support quick triage
Design for accessibility (color contrast, keyboard navigation, ARIA labels)
out_of_scope: Backend instrumentation changes (ENG to implement separate tickets)
Long-form cost analytics and billing exports (handled by Cost team)
chart_specs: Latency Sparkline: metric=latency_ms, aggregates=[p50,p95,p99], time_window=1h/6h/24h selectable, sampling=1m for 1h, 5m for 6h, 15m for 24h, chart_type=stacked-sparklines small (36x96px), y_axis=log-scale optional, tooltip=timestamp + exact percentiles + sample_count

Throughput Mini-Bar: metric=reqs_per_sec, aggregate=sum, time_window=1h rolling, sampling=1m, chart_type=mini-bar (36x72px), color=brand-blue, threshold_band=target_slo_band shown behind bars, tooltip=reqs in window + error_rate%
Tokens Per Request Gauge: metric=tokens_per_request (avg, p95), display=compact numeric + delta from baseline, color coding for >20% variance over baseline, accessible aria-label with numeric values

Cost Per 1k Tokens Trend: metric=estimated_cost_per_1k_tokens, aggregate=avg, time_window=7d/30d, chart_type=line, sampling=1h, annotation=last model/quantization change, tooltip=cost estimate methodology link
Latency Distribution Waterfall: metric=latency_ms histogram, buckets=10 log-spaced, chart_type=mini-histogram (60x140px), overlay=p95 marker, tooltip=bucket range + proportion
Cache Hit Ratio Spark: metric=kv_cache_hit_ratio, aggregate=avg, chart_type=sparkline, color=green->red gradient when <80%, tooltip=cache hits/requests
accessibility_notes: All color encodings must pass AA contrast; use pattern hatches for token-level status in exportable PNGs
Keyboard: tile must be focusable with Enter to open flyout; Esc closes flyout
ARIA: provide aria-describedby on tiles summarizing p50/p95 and throughput
ux_notes: Default tile shows 3 up-front stats: p95 latency, reqs/sec, tokens per req (avg)
Hover/focus opens a flyout with expanded sparklines and a small histogram for latency distribution
Compact colors: blue for throughput, amber for latency band, purple for token metrics, gray-muted for baselines
Mobile: collapse sparklines to single-line truncated view; allow swipe to reveal secondary metrics
